problems.q: Write the noble-gas electron configuration of Mg2+. Magnesium is atomic number 12, and the ion has lost two electrons.
problems.why: A neutral Mg atom is [Ne] 3s2. The 2+ ion loses both 3s electrons, so Mg2+ is [Ne]. OpenStax AF2e §3.4.
hints: Remove the two outermost electrons. Do not leave them in 3s.

problems.q: How many valence electrons does a neutral phosphorus atom have? Phosphorus is in group 15.
problems.why: Group 15 atoms have 5 valence electrons. Phosphorus uses the configuration [Ne] 3s2 3p3. OpenStax AF2e §3.4.
hints: For a main-group atom, the group number tells you the valence count. Group 15 is five past the previous noble gas.

problems.q: Which atom is larger, K or Br? Both are in period 4. Answer with the element symbol.
problems.why: Atomic radius decreases from left to right across a period. Potassium is farther left than bromine, so K is larger. OpenStax AF2e §3.5.
hints: In one period, the atom farther to the left is larger.
